2607.27143.title: Cost-Sensitive Conformal Prediction and Human-in-the-Loop Abstention for Imbalanced High-Stakes Decision Support: A Multi-Domain Benchmark
2607.27143.paper_summary: High-stakes decision systems in credit scoring, fraud detection, healthcare, and industrial safety require reliable uncertainty quantification under severe class imbalance and asymmetric error costs. Standard marginal conformal prediction (CP) provides valid overall coverage guarantees; however, we show that it severely under-covers rare, costly minority classes, with minority-class coverage dropping to as low as 0.5% on certain datasets. To characterize and address this limitation, we conduct a comprehensive benchmark comparing marginal CP, class-conditional (Mondrian) CP, and cost-controlled abstention mechanisms across 15 real-world imbalanced tabular datasets, 7 classification models, 3 probability calibration techniques, and 10 random seeds, resulting in 3,150 experimental runs. Our results show that Mondrian CP restores valid minority-class coverage, achieving an average minority-coverage improvement of 61.7 percentage points over marginal CP (p < 1e-80). Furthermore, combining Mondrian CP with cost-controlled abstention significantly reduces expected decision cost compared with standard decision boundaries, confidence-based rejectors, and risk-controlled rejectors under realistic human review budgets. We further quantify dataset-specific break-even thresholds at which deferring ambiguous instances to human experts becomes cost-effective. These findings provide practical guidance for deploying distribution-free, cost-aware uncertainty quantification in high-stakes decision support systems.
2607.27143.paper_summary_zh: 高風險決策系統在信用評分、詐騙檢測、醫療保健和工業安全方面需要在嚴重的類別不平衡和不對稱錯誤成本下進行可靠的不確定性量化。標準的邊際符合預測（CP）提供有效的整體覆蓋保證；然而，我們顯示它在稀有且成本高昂的少數類別上嚴重不足，某些數據集中的少數類別覆蓋率低至0.5%。為了描述和解決這一限制，我們進行了一項全面的基準測試，比較邊際CP、類別條件（Mondrian）CP和成本控制的棄權機制，涵蓋15個真實世界的不平衡表格數據集、7個分類模型、3個概率校準技術和10個隨機種子，總共進行了3,150次實驗運行。我們的結果顯示，Mondrian CP恢復了有效的少數類別覆蓋，平均少數覆蓋率比邊際CP提高了61.7個百分點（p < 1e-80）。此外，將Mondrian CP與成本控制的棄權相結合，與標準決策邊界、基於信心的拒絕者和風險控制的拒絕者相比，在現實的人類審查預算下顯著降低了預期決策成本。我們進一步量化了數據集特定的盈虧平衡閾值，在這些閾值下，將模糊實例推遲給人類專家變得具有成本效益。這些發現為在高風險決策支持系統中部署無分佈、成本意識的不確定性量化提供了實用指導。
